stories.title: Petition with 11,400 signatures demands full £550m for additional learning needs in Welsh schools
stories.summary: More than 11,400 people have backed demands for UK Government funding for special educational needs to be ringfenced for schools across Wales. stories.title: Deeside Taekwondo Academy raises £510 for breast cancer charity
stories.summary: A wear it pink evening at Deeside Taekwondo Academy has raised £510 for the breast cancer awareness charity CoppaFeel! stories.title: Neighbours and EastEnders stars are coming to Mold: Theatr Clwyd reveals its 2027 shows
stories.summary: Neighbours actor Stefan Dennis and EastEnders actor Charlie Brooks are among the names heading to Theatr Clwyd in Mold in 2027. The theatre has announced its touring programme for January to July, with drama, comedy, family shows and gigs. Dennis stars in The King’s Speech, adapted from the Oscar-winning film, from 2 to 6 February.

stories.title: Power resorted in Penyffordd following earlier outage
stories.summary: Part of Penyffordd is without power this afternoon after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 9.59pm.
